svg.title: Workflow execution connections
svg.desc: Inputs, outputs, durable state, evidence, failure, and recovery relationships for Workflow execution.

a.xlink:title: App, command, and workflow state. Stores canonical app current/action lifecycle and workflow command/current/event state.
Completion and audit evidence. Records sanitized lifecycle and completion evidence for commands, devices, apps, security, recovery, and releases.
Projection subprocesses. Own CPU-heavy projection reconstruction and serialization outside the API process.
Worker process. Consumes durable commands and owns backend execution for apps, security, recovery, releases, and lifecycle work.
Workflow execution. Coordinates multi-step workflow state through bounded event admission and process-isolated projection work.
